section-title.comment: card and panel heading, modal header, mobile menu group titles

label.comment: KPI labels (form field labels use the body role)

column-header.comment: table column headers. Sentence case, text.secondary, never uppercase

overline.comment: rare small uppercase labels, e.g. the Site label in the nav. Not for table headers

data.comment: identifiers and codes only (IDs, record numbers). Numbers and dates in tables use the body role with tabular-nums

input.focus: accent border + inset 1px ring, no offset ring (agreed 2026-11-09)

status.comment: Replaces the boxed uppercase badge. Display only.
status.a11y: The text label carries the meaning. The dot is reinforcement, never the only signal.

table.headerFont: column-header role (12px / 500), text.secondary, sentence case, no uppercase
table.identifierFont: data role (IBM Plex Mono) for IDs and codes only
table.numericFont: body role with tabular-nums for numbers and dates
table.borders: horizontal dividers only, no vertical lines
table.hoverState: {semantic.background.inset}, only when clicking the row does something. Rows in a table where only the action buttons react have no hover fill and no hand cursor. Agreed 2026-11-11.
table.sorting: Click a column header to sort, click again to reverse. Sorted column shows an up or down arrow, other sortable columns a faint double arrow (12px icons). Only on columns where the order means something, never the actions column. Sorting applies to the whole list. Agreed 2026-11-11.
table.longText: Cut off with an ellipsis, full text on hover. Action icon buttons stay visible, each with a tooltip.

dropdown.selectedState: check icon only, no fill or accent text

nav.background: {semantic.background.default} (on the page colour, no white bar)

states.current: {semantic.background.inset} fill, text.primary. No underline, no accent colour

mobile.groupTitle: section-title role (16px / 500, text.primary). Items 14px / 400 text.secondary, hover text.primary

filterTrigger.content: value only ('All hazards', 'Flood'); the field name is the aria-label
filterTrigger.activeState: {semantic.background.inset} fill, text.primary, when value is not the default

field.label: body role (14px / 400) above the control, 6px gap

datePicker.input: input spec with date segments (tabular-nums), calendar icon button
datePicker.calendar: popover, 32px day cells, selected = accent fill

emptyState.layout: centred in a card: 24px icon (text.secondary), section-title, one line text.secondary, one action
emptyState.variants: first use (primary action), no results (secondary action: clear filters)

loading.table: skeleton rows (inset fill, 12px, 4px radius, pulse) that keep the layout
loading.button: keeps width, spinner plus label, disabled while busy

errorBanner.layout: critical-bg, critical-border, radius lg, warning icon, bold message + secondary detail, 'Try again' secondary button

chart.line: 2px linear line (no smoothing), accent, no dots, 5px active dot with surface ring
chart.bar: 14px bars, 4px rounded data end, direct value labels, accent
chart.grid: horizontal lines only, border.subtle; axes text.secondary 12px
chart.tooltip: surface, border, radius lg, shadow md
chart.accessibility: role=img with a text summary, 'Show as table' on every chart, tooltip on hover and keyboard

colourRoles.categories: fixed order #2D6FA3, #eb6834, #1baf7a; max 3 when colour must separate series; passes colour-blind check (adjacent CVD dE 9.1); aqua is below 3:1 so direct labels or table are required
colourRoles.status: good, warning, critical tokens only, always with a label

tabs.style: Pill tabs in the nav trigger style: 32px high, 12px horizontal padding, hover inset at 55%, selected inset. Agreed 2026-11-09.

pagination.layout: Range text left; on the right a 'Rows per page' select, then previous and next icon buttons with 'Page x of y'. Built from Select and Button.
pagination.status: Layout agreed 2026-11-09. Rows per page agreed 2026-11-11.

dialog.bodySpacing: 8px under the header, 24px above the footer. Agreed 2026-11-09.
dialog.use: Add, edit, view, delete and import open as dialogs on the list page, not as separate pages. Errors show under their field and clear on edit. After saving, the dialog closes and a toast confirms. Agreed 2026-11-11.
dialog.blockedDelete: When an object cannot be deleted because it is in use, the dialog says so up front, says why and what to do, and has only a Close button. Agreed 2026-11-12.

topNav.siteSelector: Bordered select trigger (a switcher, not a nav item). Agreed 2026-11-09.

passwordField.trailing: Eye / EyeOff icon button, 16px, text.secondary, toggles visibility
passwordField.a11y: The toggle has an accessible label (Show password / Hide password)

inputMask.visual: None. Standard input, no extra states.
inputMask.behaviour: Formats what the user types (for example dates and codes). Behaviour only.

multiSelect.trigger: Select trigger showing the count, for example '2 hazards selected'
multiSelect.popover: Same as dropdown. Selected items show a check icon.

fileUpload.layout: Drop area, 1px dashed border (border.strong), radius lg, upload icon, text, secondary Button 'Choose files', 11px format hint (caption role)

messageBanner.layout: status background and border (1px), radius lg, 16px icon top-aligned (Info, Check, Alert, X), body-strong title plus body detail in text.secondary, padding 12px 16px, gap 12px

breadcrumbs.layout: Links in accent (body role), 16px chevron separators in text.secondary, current page in body-strong, not a link (aria-current)

accordion.header: 48px high, 12px vertical padding, body-strong title, chevron right (turns 180 degrees when open)

listbox.items: Same as menu items (32px, label only, hover inset, selected = check icon)

tree.chevron: 16px, right when closed, down when open, text.secondary

treeList.use: A hierarchy shown as rows inside a card (sectors, geographic levels). Use tree for picking inside forms and popovers.
treeList.chevron: 24px button per branch, 16px icon, right when closed, down when open
treeList.header: Column header row above, column-header role. Columns after the name have fixed widths so they line up across levels.
treeList.branchRow: Opens and closes on click. Hand cursor and inset hover fill.
treeList.leafRow: Does nothing on click. No hand cursor, no hover fill.
treeList.actions: Optional 32px icon buttons at the row end, each with a tooltip.
treeList.tools: Search filters the tree and opens the matches. 'Expand all' and 'Collapse all' are ghost buttons. A count sits in the footer.

treeSelect.layout: Select trigger plus a popover containing a tree. Built from Select and Tree, React Aria has no tree select.

listItem.purpose: Rows in a list view of records (replaces PrimeReact DataView)
listItem.layout: body-strong title, caption-role detail line in text.secondary, chevron right

segmentedButton.layout: Joined segments in one bordered container (border.control, radius md), segments 32px high, 12px horizontal padding
segmentedButton.use: Switching between views of the same data (for example Table, Chart, Map)

stepper.note: React Aria has no stepper. Built by us from basic elements.
stepper.complete: accent fill, check icon in text.inverse
stepper.current: surface fill, 2px accent border, number in accent
stepper.upcoming: surface fill, 1px border.control, number in text.secondary
stepper.label: body-strong when current, otherwise body (upcoming in text.secondary)
stepper.connector: 1px line, 48px, accent after a completed step, border.default otherwise

gapOwnership.comment: Every gap belongs to one container. Use gap on flex/grid parent. Never combine margin-bottom on child with gap on parent.

reducedMotion.comment: prefers-reduced-motion: set all durations to 1ms. Handled at component level - contributors do not implement this.

$description: Delta 2027 light theme. Normalized from the Delta v0.7.2 handoff. All 111 typed values retain their source paths below delta-2027; the prose accessibility-standard entry and component specifications remain handoff metadata. Mangrove adapter aliases follow separately. Existing Delta is unchanged.

warm.$description: Anchors #FAF9F5 (page) and #141413 (text). The other values are derived by eye. Warm page confirmed on the example screen, 2026-11-09.

default.$description: #FAF9F5 - page background (warm). White surfaces sit on it

inset.$description: hover state on rows / list items, current nav item

toast.$description: Adapter role from the handoff toast and tooltip specifications.

control.$description: Inputs, selects, secondary buttons. 3.36:1 on white, 3.19:1 on page (WCAG 1.4.11). Hover: text.secondary. Cards and dividers keep default/subtle. Agreed 2026-11-09.

primary.$description: 17.50:1 on page, 18.43:1 on white - body text, headings

secondary.$description: 6.26:1 on page, 6.59:1 on white - supporting text, labels

placeholder.$description: 2.52:1 on white, 2.39:1 on page - decorative / disabled ONLY, never informational text

default.$description: 5.37:1 on white, 5.09:1 on page - interactive elements, links

selected.$description: Adapter role from the handoff table and tree selected-state specifications.

6.$description: card padding, section gaps, tablet/desktop margin

fast.$description: tooltips, hover states, focus rings - pre-wired in components, do not use in feature code

normal.$description: dropdowns, modals, toasts - pre-wired in components, do not use in feature code

slow.$description: page transitions, large panels - pre-wired in components, do not use in feature code

default.$description: all transitions - fast out, slow to settle

targetMin.$description: Smallest clickable area, width and height (WCAG 2.5.8). Icon buttons are 32px. A smaller visual, for example a 16px checkbox, gets its size from padding or its label.

button.$description: Horizontal control padding with the component optical adjustment; consumers can override the complete padding role.
